deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's pointing words into a description that the tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus, which was not stated.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

deficiencies.description: The spoken word "circumspect" has been changed to "circumscribed".
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour is therefore circumscribed and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds "therefore", creating an unsourced causal link implying that the tumour is circumscribed and separate as a result of the fixation and dehydration process.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: has actually caused the tumor, which is, as I said, not invaded into the surrounding tissue to separate away from the normal muscle. So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Fixation and staining of the tumour, and the hydration and dehydration of the tissue slice on the slide, have caused the tumour, which has not invaded the surrounding tissue, to separate away from the normal muscle. The tumour is therefore circumscribed and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.

considerations.sourcePassage: and has, if you like, invaded within this tissue.
considerations.reason: "in a sense" has the same meaning as "if you like" in this context.

considerations.sourcePassage: I guess the expectation is that if it has invaded again into the surrounding tissues, it may have the capacity to metastasize to distant sites within the body.
considerations.reason: "I guess" is conversational filler, and the scientific hedge ("may have") was retained in the rewrite.

considerations.sourcePassage: so it might be difficult to necessarily find all of the possible secondary tumors
considerations.reason: "so" in the source text already expressed a causal result, so using "therefore" here is faithful.
